findings.title: The v5 runtime and transaction schemas do not bind the exact recovery authority or successor state
findings.reproduction: At exact packet commit 319b22023873b7f4dd83213adf791ae026546e76, validate adversarial documents with jsonschema.Draft202012Validator against planning/governance-control-recovery/governance-control-recovery-runtime.v5.schema.json and governance-control-recovery-transaction.v5.schema.json. A transaction with status FINALIZED, the fixed predecessor hash, an arbitrary all-zero backlogAfterSha256, an unrelated application-evidence SHA-256, and no packet/approval/approved-state/reviewed-state/candidate/evidence/active-hold/witness/raw-and-canonical/durability/recovery/finalization bindings reports zero errors. A runtime state with attempts=[{"forged":true}], currentSubmission={"candidateCommit":"wrong"}, and application={"ordinaryExecutionAuthority":true} also reports zero errors because those fields are generic arrays/objects. A runtime application-evidence document with ledger.path=planning/backlog.yaml, an arbitrary ledger hash, and changedPaths=["tools/gcr5ctl.py"] likewise reports zero errors. The live Windows backlog raw SHA-256 431ac0390c7aa1b1be229f741cea0b00fb73cfd24713fdcb0e8cc6a13595c7a1 differs from the reviewed commit's normalized Git blob SHA-256 3ffa93f894b5b63cbefd11d8b058eddf4deda96069aa03c9bb15bc116bc691cb, yet the transaction schema represents no canonical-content binding despite the packet's explicit raw-and-canonical CAS claim. These schema-valid substitutions contradict acceptance criteria 1, 6, 7, 8, and 9: neither the authenticated exact B02 R01 history nor the unique ledger-derived successor and crash-recovery topology is established by the approved immutable contracts.
findings.requiredRemediation: Create a strict-descendant inert R02 packet that preserves this R01 ledger append-only, references it in packetReviewHistory, and closes GCR-0005-R01-F01 only after the immutable schemas are made decision-complete. The runtime schema must define exact submission, attempt, review, state, and application structures and status relationships; bind the frozen reviewed state, candidate, evidence, adverse ledger/result/open finding, approved GCR-0005 B00 state, application evidence, exact seven-path finalization, and ordinaryExecutionAuthority=false; and reject fabricated history or application fields. The application-evidence branch must require the exact ledger path/hash/reviewed-state/result, byte preservation, the still-open GRR-0002.B02-R01-F01 finding, exact derived changed paths, checks, and an empty unverified list. The transaction schema must bind the exact packet/approval/approved-state/application-evidence commits, actor/branch, active hold, witness, reviewed state, candidate/evidence/ledger, fixed predecessor and successor planning/backlog.yaml raw plus canonical hashes, deterministic view set, canonical lock/manifest/next paths, Windows durability and flush duties, valid terminal states, fail-closed recovery decision, cleanup, and direct-child finalization. Add Draft 2020-12 negative tests for arbitrary or swapped raw/canonical hashes and paths, substituted ledger/application evidence, forged attempts/statuses, changed-path substitution, wrong hold/witness/authority, and every interruption boundary; update all affected packet, authority, proposal, review-page, and file hashes before a new independent R02 review.

verified: HEAD and candidateCommit resolve to exact packet commit 319b22023873b7f4dd83213adf791ae026546e76. Its sole parent is the adverse-ledger introduction commit 8b784cabc5d5d996c00fd2fbcc8f22a1ad05b5bb, and its exact delta adds only the seven inert GCR-0005 proposal, review page, authority manifest, packet, request schema, runtime schema, and transaction schema files; git diff --check passes.

The packet SHA-256 is exactly cf72bd1cb8106dc78caa69df206d9453c2f2cb86deaf110691dfc4c7dba8fcfa. All three schemas pass Draft 2020-12 meta-schema validation, the packet reports zero validation errors against the request schema, and every six-file packet ledger hash plus the authority-manifest hash reproduces from current exact bytes.

The frozen B02 chain is direct and append-only: candidate d363c04c385251a5d789a0313e173342e7e0ae3e is the sole parent of reviewed-state commit 962f92ff831c9a3d87a7d6ba796c8194e70b6c2c; that commit changes only planning/backlog.yaml and adds the exact evidence; adverse-ledger commit 8b784cabc5d5d996c00fd2fbcc8f22a1ad05b5bb is its sole child and adds only planning/governance-recovery-approvals/GRR-0002.B02.review-R01.json.

The S02 packet/approval, deterministic-output addendum packet/review/approval, B02 candidate/evidence, defective controller, reviewed backlog, and adverse-ledger paths, hashes, Git blobs, introductions, and ancestry reproduce. The ledger validates against the supplement-review schema and binds candidate d363c04c385251a5d789a0313e173342e7e0ae3e, reviewed state 962f92ff831c9a3d87a7d6ba796c8194e70b6c2c, CHANGES_REQUESTED, the sole HIGH blocking GRR-0002.B02-R01-F01 finding, and no closure.

Both read-only `recoveryctl supplement-status GRR-0002.S02` and `supplement-validate GRR-0002.S02` reproduce the exact `B02 scope-addendum base authority, candidates, backlog, or witness differs` failure. Before and after both failures the backlog remains SHA-256 431ac0390c7aa1b1be229f741cea0b00fb73cfd24713fdcb0e8cc6a13595c7a1 and the adverse ledger remains SHA-256 4b92f7b3a6a621e25c919f8571d7a87617966ae76a7dcbc4f3dcdd05af563e09.

The stopped boundary is exact and canonical backlog validation passes: control/minimum revision 11, sole ACTIVE HOLD-W1-GRR-0002, GRR-0002.S02/B02 in REVIEW with exact R01 current submission, W1 PAUSED at wave scope, CAP-02.S04.T03 BLOCKED, W1.A04 absent, and G1 PENDING. The witness remains exact at SHA-256 4a9d944ff95972b449b617bc384306c7023e79d31d6b427e6b6f4678cd58b22c, solely untracked and unstaged, and non-authoritative.

A bounded exceptional projection is necessary if work is to continue: ordinary supplement-review cannot record the adverse ledger, supplement-resubmit requires that adverse projection, a competing S03/B03 would violate the latest-nonapproved-supplement boundary, and direct backlog/controller/ledger edits would bypass immutable history. Keeping the stopped boundary is the safe no-mutation alternative.

The packet's intended authority is otherwise confined to GCR-0005.B00 and the exact ledger-derived adverse projection. It explicitly leaves the R01 finding open, revision 11 unchanged, all ordinary execution gates closed, and B02 R02 remediation, W1.A04, task/Wave/gate actions, hold release, main integration, and remote action unauthorized. The schema defect prevents this intent from being approved as a safe executable contract in R01.
